mechanic_notes: Six towns above the clouds; the first departure is Mango Tide.
Tram capacity is 12 passengers; the opening objective is to open the doors and board the first passengers.
The Driver ID is local-only: “Free to issue. Yours to keep. No account needed.”
Passengers get off first; steps and door latch before departure (in-game help text).

The doors animation was still “Please wait…” at the end of the capture.
